definitions.explanation: identification; an identifier used to verify identity or access accounts

examples.japanese: ID⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦パスワード→パスワード：05277_pasuwaado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}して→入力する：28127_nyuuryokusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please enter your ID and password.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧ID⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった。
⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧ID⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}きます→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: Your member ID will be sent by email when you register.

notes:
ID is the abbreviation for Identification, pronounced アイディー in Japanese. It commonly refers to usernames, account identifiers, or identification numbers.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧ID (employee ID)
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧ID (member ID)
- ユーザーID (user ID)
- ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧ID (student ID)
- ID⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧ (ID card)

DIGITAL USAGE:
- ⟦ログイン→ログイン：05276_roguin⟧ID (login ID)
- Apple ID, Google ID (service-specific IDs)
- ID⟦{認証|にんしょう}→認証：05909_ninshou⟧ (ID verification)

PHYSICAL ID:
For physical identification documents, ⟦{身分証明書|みぶんしょうめいしょ}→身分証明書：09809_mibunshoumeisho⟧ is the native term, though ID⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧ is also used.

ID PAYMENT:
In Japan, "iD" (stylized) is also a major contactless payment service by NTTドコモ, which can cause confusion with the general term.

REGISTER: Neutral. Standard vocabulary in digital and business contexts.
